notes.title: Doodle Art Halloween Contest!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Halloween is almost here so we've decided to hold a Halloween Contest! 🎃

Feel welcome to express your creativity and take a chance to win a nice reward. 🤩

[b]The contest starts today, October 21, at 5 pm GMT+2 and ends on Tuesday, November 1, at 8 am GMT+2.[/b]

If you want to participate, you need to create your doodle art using Halloween lines and/or stickers. Use your imagination to make it really Halloween-y. 🎃

When you finish your artwork, just take a screenshot, add the caption #halloweencontest and share it with visibility set on public.

In the end, we'll give 3 rewards:
1. place - DLC for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1545820/Pixel_Art_Coloring_Book/]Pixel Art Coloring Book[/url]
2. place - DLC for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1545820/Pixel_Art_Coloring_Book/]Pixel Art Coloring Book[/url]
3. place - DLC for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1507410/Coloring_Book_for_Kids/]Coloring Book for Kids[/url]

We’re looking forward to seeing all of your works. They will all be available here:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1705470/screenshots/?searchText=%23halloweencontest&browsefilter=trend&filterLanguage=default

Good luck!🍀

notes.content:

Thanks to our players for sharing what they made in our game. We hope more of you will join them and we look forward to seeing many of your interesting creations! 

In addition, we'd like to know your thoughts about our Doodle Art so feel welcome to leave us a review and tell us what you think! :)
